axes: Blender: x left/right, y toward station, z up; plaza faces negative y. GLB uses standard Y-up conversion.
origin: x=0, y=0, z=0 is the nominal facade bottom-centre anchor at provisional ground, not a geographic point.

overall_width.basis: Nominal first-pass global envelope; P1 upper surround silhouette; no scale calibration.

overall_height.basis: Nominal first-pass global envelope, not surveyed.

canopy_height.basis: P1/P2 visible broad silver upper member; nominal ratio.

canopy_depth.basis: P1/P2 projecting underside visible; unseen depth reduced to a shallow study.

canopy_front_y.basis: Estimated forward edge relative to bowed band and supports.

frame_face_width.basis: P2 silver right upright and P1 left upper return; nominal seed.

frame_depth.basis: Estimated shallow thickness; not building perimeter.

left_frame_bottom.basis: Only upper left return is sufficiently visible in P1; deliberately not mirrored to ground.

right_frame_bottom.basis: P2 right surround continues beside both curved bands; lower continuation omitted.

front_chord.basis: P1/P2 bowed frontage relative to outer surround; nominal seed.

front_bulge.basis: Two-view visible outward bow, no measured radius.

front_center_x.basis: Small asymmetry leaves a wider upper-left canopy return as seen in P1; visual estimate.

curve_end_y.basis: Nominal band chord plane; not a surveyed datum.

curve_half_angle_deg.basis: Adjustable elliptical arc shape control, not a claimed circular plan.

curve_segments.basis: Review mesh tessellation, not physical units.

silver_band_bottom.basis: P2 underside above doorway; nominal seed.

band_interface_z.basis: P1/P2 upper and lower bands meet at this estimated height.

green_band_top.basis: P1/P2 relative vertical extent; nominal seed.

silver_shell_thickness.basis: Export shell thickness only, not measured construction.

green_shell_thickness.basis: Export shell thickness only; physical material unidentified.

green_line_count.basis: Subtle geometric proxy for visible fine horizontal lining; no claim to glass block/louver units.

rear_opening_y.basis: P1/P2 visible shallow recessed window/opening plane; no upper room.

rear_opening_width.basis: Visible upper rectangular aperture simplified to a flat frame.

rear_opening_z.basis: P1/P2 visible upper opening outline, nominal seed.

upper_support.basis: P1/P2 clearly seen left upper cylindrical support; no mirrored mate added.

lower_right_support.basis: P2 clearly seen viewer-right lower round support; crowd-masked foot is separate estimated continuation.

support_red_strip.basis: P2 narrow red stripe visible on right lower support; width/height estimated.

lower_closure.basis: Deliberately shallow removable proxy for crowd-hidden lower doorway; not reconstructed interior or rear wall.

threshold.basis: P2 partial threshold and masked ground line; wholly provisional.

provisional_lower_edge_z.basis: Local bottom-centre anchor for later review; ground not surveyed.

optional_sign.basis: P1/P2 small separate sign box on upper surround; plain KOBAN only, no emblem or exact artwork.

lower_left_support.basis: P1 original pixels x240–266, y492–545 show a second lower cylindrical support and red strip. Independent position/visible length estimate; crowd-hidden continuation is a separate estimated object, not symmetry inference.
